description: Samuel Garske at the University of Sydney publishes a Sentinel-2 anomaly-detection dataset for a forested mountain area in Sequoia National Park, California. The March 2025 Zenodo archive is free under CC BY 4.0. It contains 186 training images from January 2017–July 2020 and 250 test images from August 2020–August 2023. Ten spectral bands were resampled to thirty-metre pixels in 1024-by-1024 arrays, with NumPy files and PNG previews. Snow anomalies use extremes relative to the training period; wildfire labels use image inspection and a normalised-burn-ratio threshold. These examples can test hazard-detection inputs for infrastructure-exposure simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the benchmark. The stated snow reference is Leavitt Meadows, whose representativeness for the study area was not established. Cloud filtering and training-relative thresholds may omit or relabel hazards, and the images do not measure infrastructure damage. Scene alignment, label accuracy and array contents were not independently checked.
